value: Simple miniguy endurance game featuring [ebiwwsif](https://x.com/ebiwwsif)'s original character Lilyth.

You are a hero tasked by humanity to defeat the Demon Queen, who threatens to destroy the world.
With the combined effort of the country's mages, you are teleported straight to her domain, however, there may have been a slight misconception concerning the "scale" of things...

Spam the spacebar to endure Lilyth's masturbation.
Currently the "good ending" is not implemented, so choose between running out of stamina during the finger crush or unbirth sections for 2 different endings.
